sensitive_data_exposure.name: Sensitive Data Exposure
sensitive_data_exposure.desc: An internet attacker tries to read data on assets with high data sensitivity.

credential_compromise.name: Credential Compromise
credential_compromise.desc: An internet attacker tries to obtain account credentials and domain admin rights.

lateral_movement.name: Lateral Movement
lateral_movement.desc: From a chosen foothold, the attacker tries to gain admin on other critical assets.

privilege_escalation.name: Privilege Escalation
privilege_escalation.desc: From a chosen foothold, the attacker tries to become local admin, then domain admin.

outdated_service_exploitation.name: Outdated Service Exploitation
outdated_service_exploitation.desc: An internet attacker targets assets that run end-of-life software.

step.brute_force_local: Guess a local account password ({{strength}} policy) over {{service}} on {{asset}}

step.kerberoasting: Request a service ticket for {{principal}} from {{asset}} and crack its {{strength}} password offline
